name: ken-ai
description: Kenso skills: build cold email campaigns, handle replies, report results and keep sending healthy in your Kenso workspace, through the Kenso MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Run your Kenso workspace: campaigns, replies, reports and deliverability
interface.longDescription: The skills Kenso's own agents run, for your Kenso workspace: build a campaign from an ICP to launch-ready, handle replies, review your pipeline, write client reports and keep sending healthy. The plugin connects the Kenso MCP server (https://mcp.ken.so/mcp); sign in with your Kenso account on first use. Each skill asks before it sends, launches or changes a live campaign.
defaultPrompt: Build a new cold email campaign in my Kenso workspace
Go through my Kenso replies and draft answers for me to approve
